_comment: Subsets of an extracted Data directory, for devices that cannot hold 18 GB.
Paths are matched against the 'p' field of manifest.json entries: lowercase,
forward slashes, relative to the data root. A pattern ending in /** matches
everything below that directory; anything else is matched with fnmatch.
The directories named here are the ones asset_extract actually produces.
The extractor writes each file under the WoW path it had in the archive,
lowercased, so the DBC tables land in dbfilesclient/ and the fonts in
fonts/ - there is no db/ or misc/ directory in an extraction, and a pattern
for one of those matches nothing at all.

login.summary: Login screen, character select and character creation. No world.

exclude_reasons.interface/worldmap/**: the world map cannot be opened before entering the world

world.summary: Everything in login, plus enough to enter and render the chosen maps.

exclude_reasons.interface/worldmap/**: the world map cannot be opened before entering the world

full.summary: Everything the extraction produced, minus what no client reads.

exclude_reasons.world of warcraft.app/**: a macOS application bundle from the original install
exclude_reasons.world of warcraft launcher.app/**: a macOS application bundle from the original install
exclude_reasons.background downloader.app/**: a macOS application bundle from the original install
exclude_reasons.data/enus/interface/cinematics/**: the intro movie, 117 MB, and it needs a codec the client does not ship
